decisions.reason: As the previously highlighted flagship-style cheese in the firm's strategic direction, it is still more likely to be retained than withdrawn despite the lack of later website evidence.
This semi-hard cheese wheel fits the firm's core cheese competence and established assortment, although its undifferentiated profile makes it somewhat more exposed to range simplification.
A spicy cheese line with several variants supports assortment breadth and uses existing capabilities, so management would more likely trim variants than discontinue the whole line.
The mild creamy soft cheese appears to fill a deliberate portfolio role for broader consumer appeal, making continued listing more likely than withdrawal.

The washed-rind soft cheese is the most niche and operationally demanding offer among these launches, so in a narrow organic portfolio it is the likeliest candidate to be discontinued to free resources.
